summary: Honda Motor Co., Ltd. filed a Form 6-K announcing a partial amendment to the acquisition of an additional 21% equity interest in Astemo, Ltd. from Hitachi, Ltd., converting Astemo from an equity-method affiliate into a consolidated subsidiary. The transaction was originally scheduled to close in Q1 FY2027 but is now extended to by the end of Q3 FY2027 due to pending regulatory approvals in some countries. Terms such as price per share, total value, and premium were not disclosed. The deal involves Honda increasing its stake and structural changes with Hitachi and JIC Capital Ltd. Watch for completion of regulatory approvals and the impact on Honda's consolidated financials. Risk-arb: extension of timeline adds uncertainty.
